title: Kyero Property Scraper
description: Extract property listings from Kyero search pages. Use direct URLs or location keywords.

urls.title: Search URLs
urls.description: One or more Kyero search result URLs.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Location keyword when URLs are not provided.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional extra location phrase used together with keyword.

listing_type.title: Listing type
listing_type.description: Choose property sales or long-term rentals.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language locale used for Kyero requests.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listings to store.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch per search URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Residential Proxy is enabled by default because Kyero may block direct cloud connections. Proxy usage incurs charges and access is not guaranteed. Explicit settings are respected.
